freeze: Freeze this rubric and all eight source-backed cases before round 0. Changes require a labeled new baseline, never a skill-only success.

semantic_fidelity.pass_iff: Every source-required concept, label meaning, directed relationship, order and tier is preserved; none is missing, reversed or invented. Human corrections take precedence over old generated specs. Every split has explicit complete coverage including cross-view relations. GB300 follows the last human free-software-only request.

arrow_traceability.pass_iff: Every independent link can be traced from its source stem to its unique arrowhead, with correct direction, no fake branches and crossings distinguishable from connections. Intentional source-named buses remain traceable through their specified junctions. GB300 OOB uses the requested single trunk split once; redundant datacenter independent links are never bundled. A universal one-route-per-edge rule cannot override the explicit bus request. A dot that starts away from its arrow's origin makes that arrow's direction unproven. Routes take near-minimal obstacle-safe paths: a route that loops or detours beyond what obstacles force is a defect, and the check's route-economy warnings count against this category.

layout_fit.pass_iff: Actual 77x47 half-pane captures at natural 100% zoom show every complete box and full label, without clipping or overlay occlusion. PINNED RULING: fit is proven either by a live pane's own measured header token at 77x47 @100% natural, or by a pinned direct dump of THIS view's FINAL spec at exactly 77x47 natural zoom with no overflow banner; one of the two must exist per view. Record actual live pane dimensions separately. All split views meet the same gate and have complete source coverage; panning or zooming out cannot rescue the required view. Crossings are reported and kept to a minimum by layout: a candidate may not add avoidable crossing pairs, and may not reorder source groups, layers or tiers to reduce crossings. Reducing crossings never excuses lost, reversed or merged relations.

conceptual_grouping_color.pass_iff: Related source concepts are near each other and use related hue families. Grouping is logical: the spec's group tags drive hue families and the global block order; drawn boxes, borders and titles around groups are NOT required and their absence is never a defect. When the source names tiers, tier membership must still be readable through hue families or a single non-boxed label line. Source-defined order and tiers are respected. No arbitrary alphabet cycling or color grouping unsupported by the source.

category_fit.pass_iff: The generator classifies the source into one of the six families (flow-chains, service-meshes, redundant-fabrics, lifecycle-machines, placement-planes, identity-probe-maps) and states its choice with one source-backed evidence line. The chosen family matches the source's actual structure as visible in the captures: density and fan shape, anti-parallel pairs, double-arrowhead targets, phase order, weakly-connected worlds with a bus, and identifier/qualifier density are the discriminating facts. That family's recipe is then applied and visible: chains keep short single-stage ranks with per-hop corridor room; meshes order the fan ports and keep an anti-parallel pair co-viewed as two distinct edges; fabrics pin the source's tiers and keep redundant links as independent parallel lanes without bundling or a trunk, with no dots unless the source animates them; lifecycle machines rank by source phase with the boot sequence readable in one direction and one dot per live transition; placement planes render each weakly-connected world as its own side-by-side area (spatial, not a drawn box) with one bus splitting once; identity maps cover every identifier and qualifier before layout is tuned. A recipe demand YIELDS when the generator records measured attempts proving the renderer structurally cannot satisfy it (for example one-view pairing under label sizing): a yield recorded in generation.json with that evidence cannot by itself fail this category, but the unmet recipe must then be satisfied as closely as the renderer allows. A wrong family, a missing or unsupported evidence line, or a right family whose recipe is neither applied nor evidenced-yielded fails this category; a straddling source passes only when the dominant family is named and any secondary recipe is stated and visible.

border_integrity.pass_iff: Every node side and corner is complete and uses a consistent per-node border color, including handles and selected states. ANSI or buffer evidence proves color continuity; plain text alone cannot pass. Every node border must be complete and unobstructed in its own view: any node border cell overwritten by the control palette or any other floating UI is a border-integrity defect, in normal and selected states alike.

workflow_evidence.pass_iff: Candidate skill bundle, frozen binary, rubric, dataset and spec hashes identify reproducible inputs. Fresh isolated generator identity and a separate independent critic identity on the rubric's required reviewer model, blind-first observation record, exact commands, full --check stdout/stderr/exit status, actual text plus ANSI/buffer pane captures, dimensions, states and coverage are preserved. Every probe and rejected draft is recorded through scripts/viz-evidence.sh record into attempts-log.jsonl (command, exit status, raw stdout/stderr, sha256s) and the log passes viz-validate.py --require-records; hand-kept or missing probe records are an evidence gap. No pane art is pasted into chat. Owned panes are cleaned up, including failures. Missing tools or models block rather than substitute. Live pane size is proven by the running app's own measured header token or a preserved pane-rectangle record; a hardcoded or invented pane geometry fails. A frames capture (at least 3 timestamped frames) is required for EVERY view, static ones included; its absence is an evidence gap, never a silent pass. Animated-view captures must cover a full lap of the longest route.

animation.pass_iff: Dots appear only where the source animated them; an explicit source request for no dots removes them everywhere in that case. When dots are present, timestamped actual-render evidence shows sparse, slow dots at a constant shared speed: every dot moves at the same rate, starts together at t=0, and starts at the actual start of its own arrow — the FIRST DRAWN CELL after the source port, including when that cell is a corner glyph; the check line and the capture must agree on that cell. A dot may rest on its origin cell even when it is a corner, but must never rest on any other corner, bridge, or junction, and never obscures a label. Same-arrival timing applies only when the source or user specifies it, and that arrival must be visible at the arrowheads in one frame. Evaluate all animated routes, not a single attractive frame.
animation.not_applicable_iff: The frozen source-backed manifest explicitly establishes that animation was not requested. Record the reason and source reference; unknown applicability is blocked.

aggregation.not_applicable: Only animation may have applicable=false and status=null, with a source-backed reason. It adds no pass to the metric.
aggregation.green: All applicable categories and all audited required edges pass, with complete evidence, for every one of the eight fixed cases.
aggregation.case_status: fail if any known category/edge failure; otherwise blocked if any required evidence, capability or audit is missing; otherwise pass.
aggregation.guard: No regressions on any green case; no dataset/rubric weakening; missing findings in blocked reviews cannot improve the metric. Gather all eight critiques before revision.
aggregation.stop: All green, unsupported required rendering/model capability, or the same blocker/no metric improvement after two consecutive candidate revisions. Report red matrix and exact blocker.

severity.critical: A false, missing or reversed source relationship/concept, or a violation of an explicit human prohibition, changes the diagram's meaning.
severity.high: An untraceable link, unreadable required label, missing view, misleading grouping or broken required evidence prevents reliable interpretation or verification.
severity.medium: A localized rubric violation leaves meaning recoverable but still fails the category.
severity.low: A small observable rubric violation still fails the category; severity never waives a gate.

expected.description: Source, target, direction and source-backed bus semantics; null for an extra visible relationship.

observed.description: Actual inferred endpoints/direction, stem-to-arrowhead trace, crossings and junctions; explain absence/ambiguity.

region.description: 1-based [column, row, width, height] in the referenced capture/frame.
